decisions.statement: An album named in place and as a flag is refused.
A URL that is no iCloud share is the caller's mistake.
The share link alone reaches the album.
Every photo the album has is written rather than the first page alone.
A photo is written as the original resource is stored.
Two photos with one name land under names told apart.
A call naming no folder writes into the folder the call came from.
A folder nothing is at is made before a photo is written.
An album with no photo is answered as the data.
A response iCloud could not be read from is answered as operational.
Each photo is named as soon as that photo reaches the disk.
A call that threw part way names those photos in its refusal.
The downloading this runs is handed in.
Nothing here has an Apple credential.
Nothing here writes to the album.
A JSON answer here is one object a written path rather than one document.

definition: the command writing every photo an iCloud shared album holds to disk
